text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, in the Trainer's Office—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, this photo is perfect too☆ I'm 
gonna get so many "Horse-Likes" for this♪
choice_data_list: In a good mood, are we?
In a good mood, are you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yup☆ Lately, Falco's been looking super 
photogenic for Umasta!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Her smile in this photo taken right after 
training is especially adorable♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, I don't really get 
why though~.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I'd be huffing and puffing 
after races and training... I wonder why 
that changed?
choice_data_list: Did my stamina go up or something?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah...?! Now that you mention it, you might 
be right...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure it's because Trainer gives such 
great guidance every single day~!"
choice_data_list: If that's the case, that makes me happy

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Ehehe! Falco is super happy 
too☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...All right! As a thank you, let's have a 
surprise event!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Heart-throbbing☆Umadol Falco's special 
photoshoot is about to begin♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously, if you want to express 
your gratitude to your Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The cute Falco we've polished together up 
to this point is definitely number one, 
right?♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, it's a photo op! Don't be shy, 
snap away, snap away~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the daily guidance has led to an 
improvement in Smart Falcon's stamina and 
Umadol power!
